descriptor.name: Example Pay
descriptor.description: Accept card and wallet payments through Example Pay.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.help: Secret API key from the developer section of your Example Pay dashboard. Use a test key together with test mode.

webhookSecret.label: Webhook secret
webhookSecret.help: Signing secret of the webhook endpoint in your Example Pay dashboard.

webhookUrl.label: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.help: Add this URL as a webhook endpoint in your Example Pay dashboard and select the events payment.updated and refund.updated.

refundsEnabled.label: Allow refunds from the panel
refundsEnabled.help: When off, Pano Market never asks Example Pay for a refund. Refund in your Example Pay dashboard instead.

statementDescriptor.label: Statement descriptor
statementDescriptor.help: Text on the buyer's card statement, at most 22 characters. Leave empty for the Example Pay default.

errors.authentication: Example Pay rejected the API key.
errors.unreachable: Example Pay could not be reached. Try again in a moment.

messages.connectionOk: The connection to Example Pay works.

eligibility.currency: Example Pay cannot take payments in this currency.
